# MashaAI Connect

> MashaAI Connect is an AI appointment setting platform that contacts new leads within 60 seconds of form submission, qualifies them through natural voice/chat conversation, and books the appointment directly into the client's calendar. Built for real estate teams and water damage restoration companies, where response speed determines whether a lead becomes a booked appointment or a lost job.

## Core Offering

- AI Appointment Setter: contacts leads from website forms and ad campaigns within 60 seconds, qualifies them via conversation, and books directly into the client's calendar.
- 2 call attempts plus 1 follow-up SMS per lead, included on every plan.

## Pricing

- Starter: $399/month, 100 leads/month
- Growth: $799/month, 210 leads/month, CRM integration (GoHighLevel, HubSpot), priority support
- Pro: $1,399/month, 370 leads/month, advanced CRM & API integrations, dedicated account manager
- One-time setup fee: $700 across all plans
- All plans include onboarding support and a 14-day satisfaction guarantee

## Industries Served

- [Real Estate](https://mashaaiconnect.com/real-estate.html): buyer/seller lead follow-up, viewing scheduling, property tour booking
- [Water Damage Restoration](https://mashaaiconnect.com/water-damage-restoration.html): 24/7 lead response for emergency restoration calls
